item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan holding a thick opaque book between a torch and a white wall. Light from the torch is blocked by the book before it reaches the wall.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which claim about the shadow is correct?

options.text: A dark shadow forms on the wall because the book blocks light from the torch.
An object that blocks more light makes a lighter shadow on the wall.
The book still casts a distinct shadow on the wall when the torch is switched off.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
